Najveću promenu prikazanog broja slobodnih parking mesta vidim na Donjem gradu, sa 303 na 350 slobodnih mesta, bez vremena merenja koja bi omogućila vremensko povezivanje sa tom vešću. [F13][F5]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I would add a utility check alongside the transport checks: the heating feed now carries a headline about part of the city centre lacking heat, but its event location and time remain unverified [F13]. I see the largest displayed parking change at Donji grad, from 303 to 350 free spaces, without measurement times that could place it alongside that report [F5].
